Faculty Vacancy
Thursday, 14 January 2016
6904 Hits
Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram invites applications for the under mentioned temporary posts-
1.
Professor
in TB and Chest-1 (Open)
2.
Associate Professors
in Pathology-1 (Open), General Medicine-3 (1-open, 1-SC, 1-ST) Psychaitry-1 (Open), Pediatrics-1 (ST), Surgery-2 (1-SC, 1-ST), Orthopedics -1(ST),  Obstetrics & Gynecology-2(1 ST, 1-VJ), Radiodaignosis-1 (SC),  Anesthesiology -1(SC) and Dentistry (1 Open)
3.
Assistant Professors
in Pathology-1(VJ), Community Medicine-1(Open), General Medicine-5 (2 open, 1 ST, 1 VJ, 1 OBC), Psychiatry-1 (Open), Skin & VD-1 (Open), Pediatrics-1 (ST), General Surgery-6 (3 Open, 1 ST, 1 JV, 1 NT),  Ophthalmology-2 (1 Open, 1 ST), Obstetrics & Gynecology-6 (3 Open, 1 ST, 1 VJ, 1 OBC), Radiodiagnosis-2 (1 open, 1 SC), Anesthesia-2 (1 ST, 1 VJ) and Radiotherapy-1 (SC)
The applicant should send their application along with complete bio-data with necessary academic and experience certificates/testimonials to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram. Dist. Wardha (MS) by
28th January 2016
.
Qualification: MBBS with MCI recognized Post Graduate degree in concerned subject
Experience: As per MCI and MUHS norms
Pay Scale : As per rules of Kasturba Health Society
For more details call at 07152 – 284341 to 284355 (Ext. 209)  or email at
dean@mgims.ac.in
